name: Video Grabber
author: linuxer
description: Live progress for Video Grabber downloads in the Omarchy bar: a continuous progress line, speeds, remaining time, thumbnails, and the files already saved.

barWidget.description: A download ring in the bar. Open it for live progress, speed and remaining time on everything in flight, and the files already finished.

schema.label: Refresh while downloading (milliseconds)
schema.description: The live rate, used only while a transfer is in flight. The progress bar and the bar ring animate over exactly this long, so a faster value means a smoother line at the cost of one host process per tick.

schema.label: Refresh with the panel open (seconds)
schema.description: Used when the panel is open but nothing is downloading. The live rate above takes over the moment a transfer starts.

schema.label: Refresh when idle (seconds)
schema.description: The idle rate, so a quiet bar is not starting a process every couple of seconds. New downloads are still picked up within this window.

schema.label: Finished files listed
schema.description: How many completed downloads the finished list keeps. Older entries stay on disk until the host prunes them.
